entities.name: Alela
entities.description: An uncommonly patient faerie warlock from Eldraine who favors grand schemes; survived the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Tegwyll
entities.description: Duke of Splendor who schemed for power over the high fae court.

entities.name: Rankle
entities.description: Prankster whose pranks Alela considers child's play.

events.summary: Alela aligns herself with Tegwyll, Duke of Splendor.
events.quote: Alela would go on to align herself with Tegwyll , Duke of Splendor

events.summary: At Tegwyll's coming-of-age announcement, Alela's faeries set upon the high fae with cruel pranks.
events.quote: Alela's gang of faeries set upon the high fae
